Description: Martha Galley and Annie Beaumont talk in the Living room. Martha lights the fire and discusses the situation with Annie. The piano begins playing on its own, making things more eerie. After thunder, someone collapses; the piano keeps playing.
Location: Living room（Living room）
Key Information:
  - No. 5 Martha Galley enters first and lights the fire.
  - No. 2 Annie Beaumont enters, closes the door, and asks if Martha is okay.
  - Martha and Annie talk about past memories; Martha says she is lonely and wants to rebuild their past relationship.
  - Martha mentions Edmund Galley and says he would love dancing with Annie (she recalls No. 6 Edmund Galley).
  - The piano plays by itself; Martha invites Annie to dance, trying to lighten the mood.
  - Annie feels her memory is blurry and says she can’t remember things—especially what was on the list she wrote down.
  - Thunder sounds outside; then someone falls to the ground—likely No. 5’s death—yet the piano does not stop, making the atmosphere even more tense.
Characters:
  [Martha Galley（Martha Galley）] Person No. 5, lights the fire and talks with Annie about the situation.
    · Lights the fire and talks about the past, saying she is lonely.
    · Mentions Edmund Galley and invites Annie to dance, making things feel more uncanny.
    · Invites Annie during the self-playing piano, trying to break the tension.
  [Annie Beaumont（Annie Beaumont）] Person No. 2, discusses the situation and feels her memory is blurred.
    · Talks with Martha after entering, expressing confusion about what’s happening.
    · Feels memory loss, especially about the list.
    · Is invited to dance but says she’s not good at dancing.
